landing.heroTitle: Your transcript already contains a plan. We read it and build the steps.
landing.heroBody: Nava reads your Algerian transcript, matches you against 20+ curated scholarships, and turns the result into a dated plan with a document checklist you can actually follow.
landing.step1Body: Photograph your transcript or diploma. It stays private and is used only to build your plan.
landing.step2Body: Deterministic rules score every scholarship against your real grades, level, field and funding need.
landing.step3Body: Get a back-planned timeline, a document checklist, a draft letter and a pre-submission check.
landing.trust1: We never invent a deadline, a fee or a test minimum. Unverified facts are marked and treated as unknown.
landing.trust2: We never promise admission or estimate your chances.
landing.trust3: Your documents are yours. Delete them and the derived data goes with them.
landing.faq1a: Yes for everything in this demo: matching, timeline, checklist, drafts, checks and exports.
landing.faq2q: Do you know the real deadlines?
landing.faq2a: Not yet. The catalog ships with structure only. Every date and requirement is marked unverified until a curator checks the official page.
landing.faq3a: Arabic, French and English, with full right-to-left layout in Arabic.
